description: Every field a call to converse may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

imports.description: modules the conformances import, such as the package a mapped type is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Components/Converse when left out

launch.description: one line a destination and the state the stage opens in: empty, reply(i), transcript(i, …), sources(i), source(i, "group") or weave(i, …); `contribution = source(0, "Orbital Mechanics")`

look.description: fonts and colours by role, several to a line: `title = Font.brandTitle, body = Font.brandBody, accent = Color.accent, card = #FFFFFF / #FFFFFF 0.10`; roles: title, body, body2, note, note2, accent, background, card, cardShadow, buttonShadow

mappings.description: one line a role (exchange, highlight, owner, group, document, reading): `exchange: Exchange prompt=prompt reply=reply highlights=highlights owners=owners`; a bare path is read off the value, anything else is Swift that may name `value`

prefix.description: the word the kit's types start with in place of Converse, when the app already has those names: Void writes VoidStage

readings.description: one line a word of the weave and the reading it opens: `outward: The weft is running ahead of the warp.`

strings.description: words by key, several to a line: `stage.title = "Seer", sources.royalty = "Royalty: {n}%"`; a word in quotes keeps its spaces

symbols.description: SF Symbols by key: `leading = infinity, weave = bonjour`

tuning.description: numbers by group or key: `reveal: base 15, jitter 10, wait 1.2`, `stroke.opacity = 0.20`, `palette = (0.38, 0.55, 0.38) (0.56, 0.49, 0.32)`

title: What converse takes (craft-agent/1)
